module: Gameplay selector tile generator for missions ("challenges" system). It adds one tile per mission from gameplay_missions_missions.getFilesData(true), computes its type label (dragster race, time trial, gymkhana...) and builds the details panel with a start button.
notes: A career-only mission (showInCareer without showInFreeroam) is sorted by unlock depth (gameplay_missions_unlocks.getForwardMissionInfo) and gets the cup icon; otherwise the order is -date.

Type labels: table missionTypeLabelByType for dragStripRace, dragStripAPM, generatedTimeTrial, simpleLapconfigScenario and flowgraph; drift missions other than "A to B" and avalanche without a target zone are labeled gymkhana; otherwise bigMap.missionLabels.<missionType>.
The "moreMissions" tile is added for all backends (empty validBackends).
The details labels use mission.missionTypeLabel, which may be nil (the computed label is only stored in the tile): it then falls back to the raw missionType.

onGameplaySelectorGetTiles.desc: Hook called when the selector collects its tiles. For the gameplaySelector backend, adds one tile per mission (name, preview, type, subgroup, level, beamNG icons, bug, cup, key mission_<id>). Always adds the "moreMissions" tile.

onGameplaySelectorGetDetails.desc: Hook called when the details are opened. If itemDetails.missionId refers to a known mission, adds a block (title, description, preview, favorite, general and career specifications, labels) with a start button that calls gameplay_missions_missionManager.startWithLoadingLevel(mission, nil, nil, "gameplaySelector").

details.desc: List of details blocks to complete.
